resource: Overlay entries encoded in one WORLD_OBJECT_OVERLAY snapshot
allocation_impact: Entry 487 is refused before encoding; the snapshot assembler never allocates for an unbounded overlay count.
boundary_tests: max=486: 486 overlay entries are carried in a snapshot within FND02-SNAPSHOT-CHUNK-BYTES
max+1=487: a 487th entry is refused before encoding
notes: Accepted by the resource owner in #162 comment 5864914163 (USE-WIRE-V1). Derived from the existing single-chunk snapshot byte bound FND02-SNAPSHOT-CHUNK-BYTES = 524,288 bytes (apps/game-server/src/foundation/protocol.rs MAX_SNAPSHOT_CHUNK_BYTES, the same bound encode_single_chunk_snapshot enforces), divided by the maximum encoded WorldObjectOverlayEntryV1 size as an element of the repeated `entries` field. One entry-in-field is at most 1,078 bytes: outer repeated-field tag+length (1 + 2 = 3 bytes) wrapping an entry message of at most 1,075 bytes (content_generation: 1 tag + 1 length + 32 bytes = 34; placement: 1 tag + 2 length + 512 bytes = 515, using the existing accepted FIRST_PRODUCTION_MAX_KEY_BYTES = 512 from apps/game-server/src/content/production.rs; state key: 1 tag + 2 length + 512 bytes = 515, same key bound; revision: 1 tag + 10-byte u64 varint = 11; 34 + 515 + 515 + 11 = 1,075). floor(524,288 / 1,078) = 486 (486 * 1,078 = 523,908; remainder 380 bytes < 1,078). max_payload_bytes registered for WORLD_OBJECT_OVERLAY_SNAPSHOT_V1 is therefore 523,908 bytes, 380 bytes inside the FND02-SNAPSHOT-CHUNK-BYTES hard maximum.
